svg.title: Maximum resources: tsrs vs TypeScript
svg.desc: Maximum resources: TypeScript 7.0.2 in light blue; TypeScript nightly in blue; tsrs in orange. Arithmetic means of 10 runs after 3 warmups, per project; 14 checker threads each. The tsrs legend displays 0.18.0-ts7.1.0-dev.20260929; the saved measurements were recorded with 0.17.0-ts7.1.0-dev.20260929. VS Code: tsrs 0.17.0-ts7.1.0-dev.20260929: 1.013 s and 2.102 GiB; TypeScript nightly 7.1.0-dev.20261019.1: 3.894 s and 6.589 GiB; TypeScript 7.0.2: 4.572 s and 9.095 GiB. MUI docs: tsrs 0.17.0-ts7.1.0-dev.20260929: 1.186 s and 1.567 GiB; TypeScript nightly 7.1.0-dev.20261019.1: 4.740 s and 5.730 GiB; TypeScript 7.0.2: 10.261 s and 9.585 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.17.0-ts7.1.0-dev.20260929: 0.168 s and 0.501 GiB; TypeScript nightly 7.1.0-dev.20261019.1: 0.674 s and 1.198 GiB; TypeScript 7.0.2: 0.800 s and 1.696 GiB. t3code server: tsrs 0.17.0-ts7.1.0-dev.20260929: 1.331 s and 2.414 GiB; TypeScript nightly 7.1.0-dev.20261019.1: 6.072 s and 6.488 GiB; TypeScript 7.0.2: 10.672 s and 11.178 GiB. Bars run from top to bottom: tsrs, TypeScript nightly, TypeScript. Comparison labels are relative to TypeScript 7.0.2 for the same project and mode. Faster ratios divide the reference mean wall time by the compiler's mean wall time; memory ratios divide the compiler's mean peak RSS by the reference mean peak RSS. The reference bars have no comparison labels. tsrs 0.17.0-ts7.1.0-dev.20260929: tsrs -p <project> --noEmit --incremental false --pretty false --checkers 14 --maxMemory 32G; RAYON_NUM_THREADS=14. TypeScript nightly 7.1.0-dev.20261019.1: tsc -p <project> --noEmit --incremental false --pretty false --checkers 14; GOMAXPROCS=14 GOMEMLIMIT=32GiB. TypeScript 7.0.2: tsc -p <project> --noEmit --incremental false --pretty false --checkers 14; GOMAXPROCS=14 GOMEMLIMIT=32GiB.
